svg.title: DNP3: a link frame with its CRCs
svg.desc: The DNP3 link frame of frame 4 of dnp3_read.pcap, 32 bits per row: the start bytes 05 64, length 20, control 0xc4 (DIR, PRM, unconfirmed user data), destination 2 and source 3 in little-endian, the header CRC 0x0345, then the transport byte 0xc7 (FIR, FIN, sequence 7), the application control 0xc8 and function 1 (Read), four object headers for classes 1, 2, 3 and 0 with qualifier 0x06, and the block CRC 0xac42; Dnp3Packet keeps one LinkFrame with its LinkHeader, its transport header and its application fragment.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
